distribution.narrative: Baseline review: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) records Tibet (西藏；札达底雅). 黄复生等 (2015) retains Tibet and adds Gansu, Ningxia, Qinghai, Sichuan, and Yunnan (甘肃，宁夏，青海，四川，云南). No localities are provided for the added provinces in the current 黄复生等 (2015) extraction. These additions require tracing to primary or later literature before they are treated as the reviewed current distribution.

host_note: 殷蕙芬等 (1984) and 黄复生等 (2015) both report 杏 / Prunus armeniaca; no host addition or omission is indicated between the two baseline sources.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytus nitidus Schedl, 1936.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytus nitidus
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Both baseline sources use Scolytus nitidus Schedl. The Species Reference Library currently retains Scolytus nitidus; no baseline nomenclatural conflict identified.
